notes: Card: top 4 are Hungarian ('ör', '-k' x2, ' Ü'), then ' U', ' hyper'; the − pole's output promotes raw UTF-8 lead bytes, i.e. an accented letter comes next. Probes: Vörösmarty 0.48, -középhegység 0.82, Kőbánya 0.63; Prague 0.13, UFDs 0.06. Near misses keep the Hungarian/Central-European travel topic without ö/ő/ü names.
